personal.title: Lead Engineer, Product & Engineering
personal.summary: Dedicated Lead Engineer specializing in Product & Engineering, currently based in Coimbatore. With a solid background in application support, troubleshooting, and enterprise software management, I bring a wealth of technical expertise to the table. My skills encompass programming languages such as Java and Python, along with web technologies like HTML and CSS. I am also proficient in database management with MongoDB and SQL, and I have experience with messaging systems like RabbitMQ. My role involves not just technical tasks but also team and client management, ensuring that I provide active support and efficient debugging to optimize software performance. I am passionate about leveraging technology to solve problems and improve processes, and I thrive in collaborative environments where I can lead teams to success.

responsibilities.title: Team Management
responsibilities.description: I lead a team of engineers, ensuring that everyone is aligned with our goals and objectives. I foster a collaborative environment where team members feel valued and motivated to contribute their best work.

responsibilities.title: Jira Tracking
responsibilities.description: I actively manage our project tracking using Jira, ensuring that tasks are updated and followed up on promptly. This helps us stay organized and meet our deadlines effectively.

responsibilities.title: Issue Tracking and Root Cause Analysis
responsibilities.description: I am responsible for identifying issues within our applications, conducting thorough root cause analyses, and implementing solutions to prevent future occurrences.

responsibilities.title: Bug Fixing
responsibilities.description: I take a hands-on approach to debugging, working diligently to resolve software bugs and improve overall system performance.

responsibilities.title: Automation Creation
responsibilities.description: I develop automation scripts and batches to streamline daily tasks, which enhances productivity and reduces manual effort.

responsibilities.title: Monitoring
responsibilities.description: I oversee RabbitMQ and log monitoring to ensure that our systems are running smoothly and efficiently.

responsibilities.title: Customer Support
responsibilities.description: I provide responsive customer support, including assistance via Slack, ensuring that our clients receive timely help and guidance.

responsibilities.title: Sales Day Support
responsibilities.description: I offer dedicated support during peak sales days for various marketplaces, including Shopee, Lazada, Zalora, and Shopify, ensuring that our operations run seamlessly during high-traffic periods.
